instruction:

Of the four main characters on Seinfeld, which actor is the oldest?

Here are their birth years, based on Wikipedia category data:

| Actor | Character | Birth Year |
|---|---|---|
| **Michael Richards** | Cosmo Kramer | **1949** |
| Jerry Seinfeld | Jerry Seinfeld | 1954 |
| Jason Alexander | George Costanza | 1959 |
| Julia Louis-Dreyfus | Elaine Benes | 1961 |
